title: ImageLabel
summary: Displays an image (asset id) in the GUI: icons, portraits, backgrounds. Supports scaling modes, slice-9 (ScaleType.Slice) for resizable panels, and image tinting via ImageColor3.

properties.name: ImageColor3 / ImageTransparency
properties.description: Tint (multiplies pixels — white tint = original) and opacity.

properties.name: ScaleType
properties.description: Stretch, Slice (9-slice), Fit, Crop, Tile. Slice + SliceCenter = resizable panels.

explanation.whatItIs: The GUI picture frame: renders any uploaded image inside your interface.
explanation.whyItExists: Interfaces need icons, art, and backgrounds — text alone doesn't ship.
tips: Upload images via Creator Hub; reference with rbxassetid://
ScaleType.Slice keeps borders crisp when resizing panels
ImageColor3 tints multiply — set white for true colors
commonMistakes: Using an image that hasn't been moderated/approved yet (shows placeholder)
Expecting dark icons to recolor freely — tinting multiplies, it can't brighten
Huge images tanking memory — use appropriately sized assets

examples.title: Player avatar icon
examples.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local icon = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
icon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(64, 64)
icon.Image = Players:GetUserThumbnailAsync(
    player.UserId,
    Enum.ThumbnailType.HeadShot,
    Enum.ThumbnailSize.Size100x100
)
icon.Parent = script.Parent
